mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment_history ( id, payment_id, from_status, to_status, note, error_code, created_at ) VALUES ( #{id,jdbcType=VARCHAR,typeHandler=org.tco.safepay.config.typehandler.UuidTypeHandler}, #{paymentId,jdbcType=VARCHAR,typeHandler=org.tco.safepay.config.typehandler.UuidTypeHandler}, #{fromStatus}, #{toStatus}, #{note}, #{errorCode}, #{createdAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, payment_id, from_status, to_status, note, error_code, created_at FROM payment_history WHERE payment_id = #{paymentId,jdbcType=VARCHAR,typeHandler=org.tco.safepay.config.typehandler.UuidTypeHandler} ORDER BY created_at ASC
